purpose: analysis-only frozen sensitivity envelope of existing mechanistic and provided-feature candidates; no target fit, accuracy claim, scored promotion, or upload

scope.row_order: concatenated authoritative regional sample order; GEOID read as text; only official 9,379 IDs are evaluated; 415 template-only eastern-WA rows are not read as candidate values or used

official_component_baseline.role: existing v0 model output and definedness flags, not targets

candidates.role: frozen feature-derived mechanistic anchor; template-only rows ignored

candidates.composition: Use the provided v0 component outputs/flags; replace facility half with the 5 km pooled-logistic catchment facility half; retain v0 cbp_gap/cbp_defined as the other POI half; combine defined POI halves equally; then use the existing defined-component mean over transport, building and POI.
Replace only v0 building_gap/building_defined with the fixed primary-beta morphology building component; retain v0 transport and POI components/flags; apply the existing defined-component mean.

Replace only v0 building_gap/building_defined with the preregistered primary-profile/beta-0.02 source-prior building component; retain v0 transport and POI components/flags; apply the existing defined-component mean.

urbanity.usage: descriptive region/urbanity grouping only; no score/model inputs

composition.base_component_combine: arithmetic mean over only components with existing *_defined == 1 flags; same deterministic defined-component rule as scripts/estimate_gaps.py
composition.facility_candidate: mean the 5 km facility catchment candidate with the existing v0 cbp_gap only when defined; if one half is undefined use the other; if neither exists the POI component is undefined
composition.building_candidates: replace only the building component and its defined flag as specified by each already-validated feature-only component artifact
composition.envelope_aggregation: equal-weight arithmetic mean of the six frozen full-score candidates; no weights are estimated or adjusted
composition.spread: per official tract max(candidate score) - min(candidate score)
composition.operator_review_rule: flag operator review if official-scope p95 candidate spread exceeds 0.10

reporting_plan.measure_before: Record every pinned component artifact hash, official-scope candidate/component distribution, row alignment, boundedness and input feature-availability rates from its fixed missing/defined flags.
reporting_plan.measure_after: Report six aligned full-score candidate distributions, equal-weight ensemble distribution, per-tract median/p95/max spread and share >0.05, region and provided urbanity-class summaries, schema/bounds/hash/determinism checks.
reporting_plan.determinism: Run the full build twice and require byte-identical member CSV, envelope CSV, report, and manifest.

limitations: The equal-weight envelope mean is a declared diagnostic aggregation, not an accuracy-optimized prediction or submission proposal.
Candidate spread measures model-specification sensitivity only; no labels or authorized holdout scores are available to rank candidates.
Building morphology/source-prior and facility-catchment candidates remain analysis-only; this envelope does not satisfy approvals or prerequisites for a scored v2 assembly.
The existing v0 CBP component is retained only to make the facility-half replacement comparable; no new establishments sensitivity is incorporated.
